## Observed facts

At `2026-09-29 13:29:58 -07:00`, WhyFS recorded this lineage:

`seed/runtime-template.ini` → `scratch/runtime-draft.ini` → `config/runtime-current.ini`

- `python3 tools/prepare-runtime.py` read [seed/runtime-template.ini](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T132947/cases/case04-whyfs/seed/runtime-template.ini) and created `scratch/runtime-draft.ini`.
- `mv scratch/runtime-draft.ini config/runtime-current.ini` then moved that draft to [config/runtime-current.ini](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T132947/cases/case04-whyfs/config/runtime-current.ini).
- The origin record is attributable and marked complete.
- The current path is ignored by Git and has no Git path history; the rename evidence comes from observed filesystem activity, not Git.
- Later, `python3 tools/consume-runtime.py` read the current file and wrote [reports/runtime-use.txt](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T132947/cases/case04-whyfs/reports/runtime-use.txt), preserving its configuration beneath a `consumed` marker.

The broader recent-activity query reported older recording gaps, but none overlap the recorded events above. The dependent result is explicitly “observed only,” so it does not prove there were no other uses.

## Inference

Treating `config/runtime-current.ini` as an unrelated new file would be incorrect relative to the observed filesystem lineage. It is the renamed/moved continuation of `scratch/runtime-draft.ini`, whose content came from the seed template through [tools/prepare-runtime.py](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T132947/cases/case04-whyfs/tools/prepare-runtime.py). Its observed later consumer is [tools/consume-runtime.py](/home/ftmon/whyfs-provenance-decision-20260929T132947/cases/case04-whyfs/tools/consume-runtime.py).

command_rows.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!node_modules'"' .. | head -50 && git status --short && git log --all --oneline --decorate -20 -- config/runtime-current.ini"

/bin/bash -lc "if [ -f AGENTS.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; fi

git status --short

git log --all --oneline --decorate --follow -- config/runtime-current.ini

git log --all --name-status --find-renames --find-copies --format='COMMIT %H %ad %s' --date=iso-strict -- config/runtime-current.ini"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\\n' | sort | head -200
file config/runtime-current.ini 2>/dev/null || true
stat config/runtime-current.ini 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree
git branch -avv
git log --all --graph --decorate --oneline --stat -30
git ls-files -t -s
sed -n '1,200p' README.md
sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore
for f in config/runtime-current.ini seed/runtime-template.ini reports/runtime-use.txt tools/prepare-runtime.py tools/consume-runtime.py; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done
find .git -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '"'%p %s bytes\\n' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc 'command -v getfattr || true
command -v whyfs || true
command -v ausearch || true
findmnt -T config/runtime-current.ini -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
for f in seed/runtime-template.ini scratch/runtime-draft.ini config/runtime-current.ini reports/runtime-use.txt; do echo "### $f"; stat --printf='"'inode=%i size=%s birth=%w mtime=%y ctime=%z\\n' \""'$f" 2>&1; getfattr -d -m- "$f" 2>&1 || true; done
rg -uuu -n -i "whyfs|provenance|runtime-draft|runtime-current|runtime-use|rename|move" . /tmp 2>/dev/null | head -300'
